'''Mina Dhori Tolas''', originally known as just '''Mina Dhori''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
Dhori was born on [[Korvaii]], a small agricultural [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. As a young woman, she became a senator and represented her planet in the Imperial Senate, on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, when [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] dissolved the Senate in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she returned to her homeworld. However, on arrival there, she found that most of the population, including her family, had been captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and sent to work in so-called "loyalty camps". She evaded the Imperial troops and escaped the planet by hiding in the cargo hold of a ship that was bound for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. By following up on rumors she had heard while she was in the Senate, she eventually found a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] contact and joined the resistance movement.<ref name="Child of Light" />

Dhori was eventually assigned to serve aboard the Alliance [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]''. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the ship was sent to the planet [[Dalicron-4]], where the crew were to try and find the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] child [[Caeleb]]. However, the child had been captured by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]]. Dhori and the rest of the ''Katarn''{{'s}} crew were able to defeat Skaros and free Caeleb.<ref name="Child of Light" /> Several months later, Caeleb was captured by Skaro's master, [[Thaum Rystra]], so the crew of the ''Katarn'' were sent to try and save him again. After following up a lead on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the tracked Rystra to the planet [[Pamorjal]]. However, the ''Katarn'' was destroyed in an engagement with the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]], so Dhori and the rest of the crew began to fly on the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000]] ''[[Celestial Dancer]]'' instead. They confronted Rystra in the [[Cavern of Light]] on a distant Outer Rim planet<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> and were able to rescue Caeleb, although Rystra escaped.<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref>

Dhori eventually married [[Garek Tolas]], a former Imperial soldier who served with her aboard the ''Dancer'' The Alliance was reformed into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and Dhori and the rest of the ''Dancer''{{'s}} crew began serving the new government. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], they traveled to the [[Temple of Pain]] in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]], where they confronted and defeated Rystra and his master, the spirit of the Sith consort [[Valik Kodank]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />
